Adventurers lucky enough to make it to this outpost are treated to blue waters and lush foliage, as well as all the goods and services available at outposts throughout [[Tyria]].}} [[Destiny's Gorge]] is one of the few outposts within the Crystal Desert. It is home to two of the secondary profession changers. ==Getting there== Leaving from [[Augury Rock (outpost)]], head northeast until you find a chasm filled with plants, water, and [[Losaru]] [[Centaur]]s.
